description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseParam' used as a base for parameter handling within an API framework. It provides methods for configuring parameters, setting options, and serializing parameters to JSON, leveraging Symfony's OptionsResolver and dependencies like ValidatorFactory and BeanManager.

classes.name: BaseParam
classes.description: An abstract base class for API parameter objects, handling configuration and serialization of parameters used in API requests or responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator factory and bean manager dependencies.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the parameter object using provided arguments, setting up options via OptionsResolver.

methods.name: setDefined
methods.description: Can be overridden to define specific options; by default, empty implementation.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement parameter-specific configuration logic.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets options by instantiating option classes and adding them to the OptionsResolver; throws exception if option class does not exist.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the parameters array for JSON serialization.
